rationale: Khronos standards, immutable source/build dependency admission, SDK materialization, distribution classification, host capability observation and current-host evidence qualification are deterministic fail-closed governance operations. Decision Fabric must not choose standards, expand providers, select hardware, override HRB placement, weaken conformance, alter immutable pins, decide distribution rights, or promote runtime evidence. Any later workload-specific ranking remains owned by the already-canonical consumer fabric after deterministic eligibility and HRB admission rather than by this Khronos adoption layer.
not_delegated: immutable source or build-dependency pin selection at runtime
HRB placement, reservation or lease authority
Vulkan/OpenCL/OpenXR loader, ICD or runtime override

project_radar_review.scope: Khronos Open Standards SDK Fabric against current FA3 HRB, Hardware Safety Envelope, Software Coexistence, Distribution Compliance, Reuse Discovery and current-host evidence boundaries
project_radar_review.note: The Khronos layer supplies standards, adapters and deterministic validation surfaces. It does not own candidate ranking or execution authority.
